location.description: nextcloud://host[:port][/folder], the folder being relative to the user's files

password.description: App password of the user, see Settings > Security

prefix.description: URL path Nextcloud is installed under, for example /nextcloud

insecure.description: Talk plain HTTP to the server

trash.description: Also back up the trash bin, under /trashbin

versions.description: Also back up the kept versions of every file, under /versions; one request per file
